name: Put
description: Put is a trick-taking card game that involves tricks, trump, following suit. The game originated in Europe and has become popular worldwide.

content.text: Put is a trick-taking card game that involves tricks, trump, following suit. The game originated in Europe and has become popular worldwide.

Country/Region of Origin: England
Time Period: Sixteenth to nineteenth century
Historical Development: Put was played in England from the sixteenth to the nineteenth century; rules recorded by Willughby (1672) and Cotton (1674); related to Truc (France/Spain) and Truco (South America).
Cultural Significance: English tavern game of the period; popular in servants' quarters with loo, whist, all fours.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
